text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by about 40%. Most of that time went to prep for the next meeting, not extra calls.

**2. CRM quality improved.** Notes were more complete and consistent. Managers finally saw next steps and objections in the same format across the team.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. A short, upfront heads-up fixed most of it.

**4. Accuracy isn't perfect.** Product names and pricing details needed a quick human check.

**5. Adoption followed trust.** Reps who reviewed summaries early kept using the tool.

Our takeaway: AI handles the typing, but reps still own the relationship.

What would you want from a note-taker?
